迷你音乐3

MiniMax的音乐生成模型，可创建长达5分钟的完整歌曲，结构稳定，音质高。两个输入驱动它： 字幕 （结构化音乐描述：风格、情绪、人声、编曲）和 歌词 （与 [intro] [verse] [chorus] [bridge] [outro] 控制歌曲结构的标签）。

参数

参数

描述

字幕

音乐描述。将其分为三个部分——全局元数据→ 声乐细节→ 安排。越具体，结果越接近。

歌词

歌词+章节标签。标签是唯一可执行的结构指令；抒情文本本身只传达情绪。

最大持续时间

目标歌曲长度（秒）（默认120=2分钟；该型号最多支持~300秒/5分钟）。较长的歌曲需要更多的时间和VRAM。

种子

这一代的随机种子。保持固定以再现同一首歌；改变它以获得不同的看法。

模型文件

扩散模型/文本编码器/VAE。

平铺解码

在重叠的图块中解码音频VAE，以大幅降低VRAM使用率，这对低VRAM GPU上的长歌很有帮助。速度稍慢，瓷砖边界出现接缝的风险很小；在高VRAM GPU上关闭它以获得最佳质量。

快速写作指南

你可以找到一个官方 音乐字幕重写技巧

[Intro]	前奏	歌曲开头，通常没有歌词，用乐器建立氛围。
[Verse]	主歌	负责讲述、铺陈内容；不同主歌的歌词通常不同，情绪相对克制。
[Pre-Chorus]	预副歌	位于主歌和副歌之间，逐渐抬高情绪，为副歌蓄力。
[Chorus]	副歌	歌曲最核心、最容易记住的部分，旋律和歌词通常会重复，情绪也更强。
[Post-Chorus]	后副歌	接在副歌之后，常用简短重复句、哼唱或旋律钩子延续高潮。
[Bridge]	桥段	后半段出现的对比段落，旋律、和声或情绪通常与主歌、副歌不同，避免歌曲过度重复。
[Instrumental]	器乐段	没有人声歌词，由多种乐器演奏，例如古筝、二胡和钢琴共同演奏的间奏。
[Solo]	独奏段	突出某一种乐器，例如二胡独奏、古筝独奏或吉他独奏。
[Outro]	尾奏／结尾	歌曲最后的收束部分，可以无人声，也可以逐渐淡出。

### Global Metadata
Genre: Contemporary R&B fused with narrative Chinese hip-hop rap
Subgenres: Old-school R&B groove, street storytelling rap, dark humorous cinematic rap
Tempo: Mid-tempo, 92–98 BPM, laid-back yet punchy 4/4 beat
Emotional arc: Opens with casual deadpan conversational banter, builds tension through escalating verbal confrontation, ramps up in the pre-chorus, erupts into an anthemic call-and-response chorus, delivers a gritty rapid-fire rap verse, and closes with the fading chorus hook
Sonic profile: Warm lo-fi R&B production texture, crisp drum machine rhythm, deep sub-bass foundation, muted electric piano chords, subtle vinyl crackle, intimate room ambience, vocals placed front and center in the mix

### Vocal Details
Lead vocal: Male lead vocalist in mid-low register. Verses delivered in natural conversational rap flow with gritty street-style cadence, retaining the spoken-word texture of the original dialogue; pre-chorus grows more aggressive and punchy; chorus shifts to chant-like melodic R&B delivery with a rough, powerful timbre
Vocal production: Light compression, subtle room reverb, no heavy auto-tune or pitch correction, preserves the raw conversational character and narrative tone
Backing vocals: Sparse call-and-response ad-libs in the chorus, low-mixed harmony layers supporting the hook, no dense vocal stacks

### Arrangement
Intro: 4-bar ambient opening. Muted electric piano lays down warm R&B chord voicings, soft kick taps establish the tempo, faint vinyl crackle builds lo-fi atmosphere. Lead spoken vocal enters with the opening dialogue, supported by minimal percussive clicks.
Verse: Full drum groove drops with crisp snare, steady hi-hats and a deep sub-bass line. Lead rap vocal carries the narrative dialogue; electric piano continues as the harmonic backbone, occasional percussive fills accent key punchlines. Dynamics stay restrained to foreground the storytelling.
Verse: Beat remains consistent with subtle added shaker layers. Rap delivery grows more assertive, matching the escalating tension of the dialogue. Subtle bass note variations underline dramatic beats.
Verse: Groove continues unchanged, rap cadence tightens further as the argument intensifies. Sparse snare rolls build subtle forward momentum toward the pre-chorus.
Pre-Chorus: Drum pattern intensifies with added snare rolls and elevated bass energy. Vocal delivery becomes more forceful and punchy, rising steadily in intensity. Filtered synth swells build tension leading directly into the chorus.
Chorus: Arrangement thickens fully. Layered vocal chants carry the anthemic hook, a warm synth pad fills the mid-range, the bass line becomes more melodic and pronounced. Call-and-response vocal layers create an immersive, crowd-like dramatic feel.
Verse: Beat strips back slightly to center the rapid-fire rap verse. Tighter snare pattern, added percussive clicks, aggressive rap delivery with sharp cadence. Subtle bass stabs accent each lyrical punchline.
Chorus: Full arrangement returns with elevated energy. Additional ad-lib layers reinforce the hook, the drum pattern adds minor variations, overall intensity peaks here.
Outro: Beat gradually decays, drum elements drop out one by one, electric piano chords slow and soften. Final vocal echoes dissolve into soft room ambience, fading out cleanly.
